from.place: steps 3-5: categorical realization after finite presentability

title: Generic ind realization by finitely presentable objects
statement: Let C be a category with hom sets in universe v and filtered colimits indexed by small categories in Type v. Let P be an object property of C whose full subcategory is essentially small in universe v and such that every P-object is finitely presentable for these filtered colimits. Then there is a functor Φ : Ind(P.FullSubcategory) → C whose restriction along Ind.yoneda is naturally isomorphic to P.ι, which preserves the canonical presentation colimit of every ind-object, is full and faithful, and whose essential image is ObjectProperty.ind P. No isomorphism-closure assumption on P is required.

source.place: paragraph (2), essential-image clause, and unit step 1 (small skeleton)

proof.text: Let F be the full-subcategory inclusion and N the presheaf-valued restricted Yoneda functor. Construct RZ as the actual colimit of the chosen small filtered presentation of Z after F. The presentation universal property and Yoneda evaluation give inverse maps Hom(RZ,Y) and Nat(Z,N(Y)). Postcomposition is compatible with this equivalence. Define R on morphisms by its inverse applied to precomposition; injectivity proves the identity and composition laws.

Transfer arbitrary filtered colimit cocones along the preceding Hom equivalence. The ind inclusion preserves filtered colimits, so the transferred cocone is universal. This proves that R preserves filtered colimits. Apply Yoneda evaluation to the Hom equivalence on representables to construct a natural isomorphism Ind.yoneda composed with R to F.

Finite presentability says each evaluation of N preserves filtered colimits, hence N itself does so. Full faithfulness of F identifies each representable with N(F(X)). Thus the presheaf presentation of Z and the nerve of the defining colimit for RZ are colimits of naturally isomorphic diagrams. The canonical map Z to N(RZ) is their comparison, hence invertible. The Hom equivalence and this invertible map give explicit inverse functions for R on every Hom set, proving fullness and faithfulness.

Every RZ is by definition a filtered colimit of P-objects. This property transports across isomorphisms. Conversely lift a filtered P-presentation of M into the full subcategory, take its ind-colimit, and use preservation of filtered colimits and the Yoneda restriction isomorphism to identify its realization with M. This proves the essential-image equality.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (2), the essential image clause, and the universal property of colimits

lean.statement:
theorem ind_realization_of_finitelyPresentable
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [HasFilteredColimits C]
    (P : ObjectProperty C) [EssentiallySmall.{v} P.FullSubcategory]
    (hP : ∀ X : P.FullSubcategory,
      IsFinitelyPresentable.{v} (X.1 : C)) :
    ∃ Φ : Ind P.FullSubcategory ⥤ C,
      Nonempty (Ind.yoneda ⋙ Φ ≅ P.ι) ∧
      (∀ Z : Ind P.FullSubcategory,
        Nonempty (IsColimit
          (Φ.mapCocone (colimit.cocone ((Ind.presentation Z).F ⋙ Ind.yoneda))))) ∧
      Φ.Full ∧ Φ.Faithful ∧
      (∀ M : C, Φ.essImage M ↔ ObjectProperty.ind.{v} P M)
